result.title: Route-and-Generate: KL-Regularized Router Improvement for Reasoning Routing in LLMs
result.summary: Large language models often apply complex reasoning indiscriminately, leading to overthinking on simple tasks and underthinking on harder ones. We present Route-and-Generate (Rouge), a hierarchical training framework that enables LLMs to adaptively decide when and how much reasoning is required for each input. Our approach decouples reasoning effort allocation from answer generation by introducing a routing policy that allocates a fixed sampling budget across multiple reasoning formats, while the base model is optimized with GRPO using per-sample rewards. To promote efficient reasoning, we employ a rank-based reward that favors shorter correct solutions, and update the routing policy via a closed-form KL-regularized policy improvement step distilled into a neural router. This design encourages concise answers on easy problems while reserving longer reasoning for harder ones, achieving improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across multiple reasoning benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Route-and-Generate（Rouge）分层训练框架：用路由策略在多种推理格式间分配固定采样预算，基模型以 GRPO 和偏向简短正确答案的 rank-based reward 优化，路由策略经闭式 KL 正则策略改进后蒸馏成神经路由器，以按输入自适应决定推理量与长度。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本的「何时思考、思考多少」路由与长度—正确率权衡，可为 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的收益成本估计、推理预算分配及路由器稳定训练提供可核查的方法线索，但未涉及视觉证据筛选，迁移需自行验证。
